t: The 4lite Marinus Square up and down wall light is a mains-powered outdoor luminaire designed to deliver bi-directional illumination. Ideal for illuminating domestic doorways, patios, and garden pathways, this modern anthracite fixture enhances exterior security and visual appeal. Constructed with a durable marine-grade stainless steel body and a robust plastic lens, the weather-resistant unit withstands outdoor elements. The fitting requires 2 x GU10 bulbs, up to a maximum wattage of 50W, to provide reliable and bright illumination. Wall-mounted installation is straightforward with the supplied fixings, making it a practical choice for trade professionals.
b: Includes Wall-Mounted Fixings for Easy Installation
